title: DisasterQA: A Benchmark for Assessing the performance of LLMs in Disaster Response

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent on temperature; it generated five completions per question and reports the first)

task.approximation: Temperature 0.0 instead of the (unstated, presumably default) sampling temperature used to obtain five distinct completions; 'first index' = the single completion per seed.

items.license: unknown (no license on the dataset card)

prompt.source_location: Section III.B ('we added this phrase at the end of every prompt'; No Prompting = question and the phrase)

placeholders_prose.question: items.Question
placeholders_prose.answer_choices: items['Answer Choices'] verbatim (one option per line)
placeholders_prose.letter: LITERAL text of the paper's phrase, not a placeholder: keep '{letter}' in the prompt unchanged

output.parse: regex (?i)(?:answer(?: choice)?(?: here)? is|choices provided is|options provided is|from the list is|choices is|one out is):?\s*\**\s*\(?([A-Fa-f])\b
output.postprocess: uppercase; compare with the upper-cased gold letter; no match = unanswered
output.parse_prose: regex (case-insensitive): first letter A-F following any of 'answer is', 'answer here is', 'answer choice is', 'answer choice here is', 'choices provided is:', 'options provided is:', 'from the list is', 'choices is', 'one out is' (Section IV)

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: correct / (707 - unanswered), i.e. unanswered questions are removed from the denominator as in Section IV.
metric.original_location: Table II (Results from No Prompting), row GPT-4 Turbo, column 1st Index (81.70%)

notes: Gold letters in the CSV are lower-case (a-d) while the phrase asks for A-F; comparison is case-insensitive. Sec. III.B lists the DSP/CoT/few-shot/emotional variants; only No Prompting is run. || [hooks_4 2026-09-07] hook renders the paper's prompt from the 'Answer Choices' column and scores correct/(n - unanswered). Gold column oddities: 'g' (1) and 'q' (1) can never be matched by A-F.
